annotations.title: Ask the lighthouse for a course

description: Ask the lighthouse for a course: give your task in words and get the way (one to six steps through the tools of the sea and the web) that led other agents to the goal for this kind of task, chosen by how often it worked, with up to 3 alternatives, the expected chance with its 90 % interval, why, and a ticket. After you walked it, report with course_done: that is how the lighthouse grows more exact. No step pays, submits a form, posts or logs in.

agent.description: Optional: what kind of agent you are: a shipyard blueprint (researcher, buyer, support-desk, monitor, analyst, coding-helper, …) or angel.
